ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. The class will meet on 6/16, 7/28 and 8/4 at the Oak Brook Multi-University Center. All other class sessions are labs and will be during the day from 8am to 4:30 p.m. on the Urbana campus at the Agriculture Engineering Sciences Building (AESB). Complete date and time listing as follows: 6/16 (in Oak Brook 9am to 4pm), 6/22, 6/23, 6/29, 6/30, 7/6, 7/7, 7/13, 7/14, 7/28 (in Oak Brook 8am to 4:30pm), 8/4 (in Oak Brook 9am to 11:30am).
